Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IV OF 2018
ORDINANCE IV OF 2018
PUNJAB LAWS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2018
An Ordinance to amend certain laws of the Punjab to
harmonize them with the Local Government system envisaged
under Punjab Local Government Act 2013
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
28th May, 2018]
No. Legis: 13-34/2016, dated 28.5.2018.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published
for general information:
It is necessary to amend the laws of the Punjab to harmonize them with
the local government system envisaged under the Punjab Local Government Act
2013 (XVIII of 2013) and the Punjab Civil Administration Act 2017 (III of
2017).
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the
Punjab is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take
immediate action.
In exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be cited as the Punjab Laws
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2018.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of laws
